description: `.chart-version` is deliberately NOT watched by renovate. argocd-projects is the gate -- its targetRevision is the only chart pin the cluster deploys from (homelab#1031) -- and renovate now watches that repo directly. Watching both meant one upgrade produced two PRs, and merging the one here first put the repo ahead of the cluster: exactly the drift homelab#1063 audits for. This file stays, because helm-validate-action reads it to pick the chart schema to validate values.yaml against; it now FOLLOWS the gate instead of racing it.
